english: For a real number $b$, let $L_{b}$ denote the line $(3-4i)z+(3+4i)\bar{z}+b=0$ in the Argand plane, where $i=\sqrt{-1}$. Let $b_{0}$ be the greater of the two values of $b$ for which $L_{b}$ touches the circle $|z-1-2i|=2$, and let $L_{b_{0}}$ touch this circle at the point $z_{0}$. Then the value of $\mathrm{Re}(z_{0})-\mathrm{Im}(z_{0})$ is ______.
hindi: एक वास्तविक संख्या $b$ के लिए माना कि $L_{b}$ आर्गण्ड तल में रेखा $(3-4i)z+(3+4i)\bar{z}+b=0$ को दर्शाता है, जहाँ $i=\sqrt{-1}$ है। माना कि $b$ के उन दो मानों में से, जिनके लिए $L_{b}$ वृत्त $|z-1-2i|=2$ को स्पर्श करती है, बड़ा मान $b_{0}$ है, तथा $L_{b_{0}}$ इस वृत्त को बिन्दु $z_{0}$ पर स्पर्श करती है। तब $\mathrm{Re}(z_{0})-\mathrm{Im}(z_{0})$ का मान ______ है।
solution: $z\bar{a}+\bar{z}a+b=0$ with $a=3+4i$: $2(3x+4y)+b=0$; distance of $c$ from it is $\dfrac{|c\bar{a}+\bar{c}a+b|}{2|a|}$
Line $3x+4y=1$; at the centre $3+8=11>1$, so the contact point is $c-2\cdot\dfrac{a}{|a|}=1+2i-\dfrac{2(3+4i)}{5}=-\dfrac{1}{5}+\dfrac{2}{5}i$
solution_full: With $a=3+4i$, the line $z\bar{a}+\bar{z}a+b=0$ is $2\,\mathrm{Re}(z\bar{a})+b=0$, i.e. $6x+8y+b=0$, with normal along $a$.
The circle has centre $c=1+2i$ and radius $2$. The distance of $c$ from $L_{b}$ is $\dfrac{|6+16+b|}{\sqrt{36+64}}=\dfrac{|22+b|}{10}$.
Tangency: $|22+b|=20$, so $b=-2$ or $b=-42$. The greater value is $b_{0}=-2$, giving $3x+4y=1$.

The point of contact is the foot of the perpendicular from $c$ to the line. Along the unit normal $\dfrac{a}{|a|}=\dfrac{3+4i}{5}$, the value of $3x+4y$ at $c$ is $11$, larger than $1$, so we move from $c$ in the direction $-\dfrac{a}{|a|}$ through the radius $2$.
originality_note: New: tangency of a family of complex-form lines to a circle, then the contact point read off as the centre moved along the unit normal a/|a| (way 3). Closest known: condition for z abar + zbar a + b = 0 to touch a circle (textbook). Different because: the point of contact and the choice of branch (greater b) are asked, which needs the side of the centre; this is a routine variant and is flagged as a standard ingredient.
